## Procedure

1. A series of bags (approximately 24 in. high) are laid out in a line on the ground with approximately 24 in. between bags
2. Jump over the first bag, tucking both knees in toward the chest (-21)
3. Drive both arms upward when exploding off of the ground to assist in reaching optimal jump height
4. Upon landing, immediately explode upward over the next bag in the series
5. Sprint 5 yards following the final bag jump

## Coaching Points

- Smoothly transition between running speeds
- When decelerating to a slower speed, sit into a shallow (three quarter) squat as opposed to sticking the chest out
- Sprint at full speed for the entire designated distance before decelerating
